method: STRIDE-inspired minimal trust boundary register for UI/consumer/provider, not a pentest

threats.scenario: Distinct account-exists/locked messages or timing leak identities
threats.impact: credential/session compromise, privacy or unauthorized operation as applicable
threats.uiResponse: Generic comparable status/content and accessible safe reset confirmation
threats.backendControl: Response timing/rate limit and log minimization
threats.requiredDetection: Redacted event with opaque correlation ID from server; no secrets or user-supplied raw logs
threats.acceptanceTest: Check existing/missing accounts indistinguishable in UI and backend timing audit
